performance_claim_scope: Radeon 8060S/gfx1151 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B GGUF Q4_K_M/BF16-KV eager decode at 128K; clean 24-step ROCTX profile plus balanced reducer microbench

candidate.policy: Parallelize only independent exp and normalization work when num_splits > 256; retain serial max, denominator sum, and final output accumulation order. The <=256-split body is unchanged.

hardware.device: AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 395 / Radeon 8060S Graphics

protocol.attribution: One clean detached eager-decode process per context at baseline commit 631498dd; four warmup steps and 24 timed steps enclosed by exact ROCTX marker windows; cached builds required; graph replay disabled.
protocol.clean_confirmation: One clean detached candidate process at commit 71e61524 with the same 128K profile command and timing scope.
protocol.microbench: Thirty balanced reducer event samples per mode at 256 and 512 splits.
protocol.publication_note: The profile is causal kernel evidence. The separate right-sized one-warmup/three-measurement model sweep supplies public graph-decode medians.

baseline_attribution.selection: Attention becomes the context-local majority only at 128K. The reducer is a bounded exact opportunity; the 512 dense-Q8 ordering is not transferred to 128K by assumption.

rejected_candidate.name: all-eight-query-head register tile
rejected_candidate.correctness: Production output and partials byte-exact at contexts 1, 255, 256, 257, and 4096.
rejected_candidate.decision: Rejected and removed; register pressure/occupancy loss dominates.

256_splits_control.interpretation: The scoped <=256 serial route is performance-neutral.

correctness.boundary_fixture: The 256/257 split CPU contract passes and catches unsafe reuse of split metadata as reducer scratch.
correctness.random_ab: Baseline/candidate output is byte-exact for all 4096 BF16 values at 512 splits.
correctness.focused_tests: Paged-attention registry/plan plus direct-gate bundle passes 8/8.
correctness.gpu_smokes: Cached gfx1151 gate-bf16, gqa, and gqa-state smokes pass with zero BF16 mismatches and NumPy max abs 4.1e-08.
correctness.cpu_fixtures: scripts/smoke.py --mode cpu-fixtures passes all seven fixtures.
correctness.trace: The clean trace contains the expected reducer kernel at 196.466 us/call with 16 VGPR and zero scratch.
correctness.known_unrelated_blocker: scripts/check_fixtures.py stops on the pre-existing nested moe/moe_ffn_selected_gguf_q4_k.json schema after four prior fixtures; this is not caused by LCP-D1.

decision.reason: The scoped long-split reducer is byte-exact, leaves <=256 splits on the original serial body, has no scratch, and improves the clean 128K reducer, attention window, total GPU window, and profiled host wall.
decision.next: The independent right-sized 1+3 gate completed and publishes 28.047 graph-decode tok/s at 128K in benchmarks/results/2026-07-14-gfx1151-gguf-lcp1-lcpd1-right-sized-3run.json.
